features.name: content_length_log_normalized
features.description: Log-transformed and normalized article content length, smoothing the heavy right skew for linear separability
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides smooth continuous signal about article length which differs across channels; log normalization helps linear margins

features.name: lexical_diversity_score
features.description: Composite lexical diversity combining unique token ratio and non-stop unique token ratio, indicating vocabulary richness
features.expected_model_benefit: Different channels have distinct vocabulary richness patterns; tech and world news tend to use more specialized vocabulary

features.name: media_richness_index
features.description: Weighted composite of images and videos normalized by typical maximums, measuring multimedia content density
features.expected_model_benefit: Entertainment and lifestyle channels tend to have more images; tech channels may have more videos; useful linear discriminator

features.name: self_link_ratio
features.description: Ratio of self-referential hyperlinks to total hyperlinks, indicating how much an article references its own domain
features.expected_model_benefit: Channels like lifestyle and socmed may have higher self-referencing patterns; useful for linear separation

features.name: sentiment_polarity_normalized
features.description: Global sentiment polarity shifted and scaled to [0,1] range for smooth linear model input
features.expected_model_benefit: Sentiment varies by channel; entertainment tends positive, world news may be more negative; smooth normalization aids SVM margins

features.name: subjectivity_polarity_interaction
features.description: Product of subjectivity and absolute sentiment polarity, capturing emotionally charged subjective content
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures interaction between how subjective and how emotionally charged content is; useful nonlinear signal for linear SVM via feature engineering

features.name: positive_sentiment_dominance
features.description: Ratio of positive word rate to total sentiment word rate, measuring positivity dominance in sentiment-bearing words
features.expected_model_benefit: Channels differ in tone; lifestyle and socmed tend more positive while world news may be more negative; linear discriminator

features.name: keyword_density_score
features.description: Normalized keyword count scaled to [0,1] range, indicating how keyword-rich the article metadata is
features.expected_model_benefit: Articles with more keywords are better indexed; different channels may have different keyword strategies useful for linear separation

features.name: word_complexity_score
features.description: Normalized average token length indicating vocabulary complexity and reading level of the article
features.expected_model_benefit: Tech and business articles tend to use longer, more complex words; entertainment uses simpler language; smooth linear signal

features.name: link_density_per_content
features.description: Log-ratio of hyperlinks to content tokens, measuring how link-heavy the article is relative to its length
features.expected_model_benefit: Tech and business articles tend to have more external references; captures structural differences between channels

features.name: title_topic_relevance_score
features.description: Semantic score from 0 to 1 assessing how strongly the article title signals a specific topical domain (technology, world affairs, entertainment, business, social media, lifestyle) based on presence of domain-specific terminology, named entities, and topic markers in the title text
features.expected_model_benefit: Title language is highly predictive of channel; explicit topic signals in titles provide strong linear discriminating features for SVM

features.name: content_formality_index
features.description: Numeric score from 0 to 1 estimating article formality based on combination of average token length, subjectivity level, and sentiment polarity magnitude; higher scores indicate more formal, objective writing style typical of news and business reporting
features.expected_model_benefit: Formality distinguishes world/business news from entertainment/lifestyle; provides interpretable continuous signal for linear SVM decision boundaries
